title: Pin leave-then-resolve: a grid weight committed by leaving the cell, its save resolving after the blur, must not also fire rested()
evidence: Done by PR 1721: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.onboarding-pins.test.tsx 'US-62 AC25b (H96)' types the last weight in the vitals grid's New column, leaves the grid, holds its save until after the blur, and expects no landing. Dropping the cell's left (useLeaveField(undefined) in InputPanel.tsx) makes it land after the save resolves; dropping commit()'s rested() too makes it pass, so the pin is on that rested() finding the landing spent. On main commit() calls rested() for every saved New weight, so the pin is on the landing, not on rested() never being called. Was: From PR 1579 review R1. widget-src/src/components/StartingInfoVitals.tsx: rested() is called only from advanceToRest (line 307 on claude/confirmed-values); commit() (lines 389-414, run on leave by useSaveOnLeave at line 417) awaits onSave, then settle() and setActiveCell(null). That a leave-commit whose save resolves after the blur does not also call rested() is reasoned from code only. Add a test that holds onSave open, blurs the cell, resolves the save and asserts rested was never called. (H96)
